name: traceweaver-NCO2026
technique: static ELF disasm: recognize inlined RC4 (KSA div+swap loop, PRGA xor loop) and extract key/ciphertext; watch ABI register-residue implicit args across calls
when_to_use: small static ELF with ptrace anti-debug + memcmp + scanf, no flag plaintext; a function that seems to clobber input may actually load the RC4 key into live registers consumed by the next call
commands: objdump -d -M intel; track rsi/rdx/rcx residue at call sites; RC4 decrypt with stdlib python
